articles.title: Father set to be sentenced in New York for the murder of nine-year-old Montreal girl
articles.summary: ELIZABETHTOWN — A Montreal man found guilty of drowning his daughter in a creek in Upstate New York is set to be sentenced today in Essex County Court.

articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — It was something most people have likely done at one time or another: complain to others about feeling judged or dismissed during an interaction, maybe even take to social media to post about it.

articles.title: 'Very special day': Kawhi Leonard receives warm welcome during Raptors' re-debut in pre-season
articles.summary: Kawhi Leonard received the loudest ovation during team introductions as he made his re-debut for the Toronto Raptors. Leonard was in the starting lineup as Toronto hosted the New York Knicks in a pre-season game on Tuesday night.

articles.title: Why 18 candidates are fighting for this Toronto council seat
articles.summary: With longtime councillor Paula Fletcher stepping down, Ward 14 (Toronto-Danforth) has drawn 18 candidates looking to claim the open seat on city council. CBC’s Dale Manucdoc breaks down the crowded battleground.

articles.title: U.S. court denies bail to alleged Tumbler Ridge shooting conspirator James Bryant
articles.summary: SEATTLE — The suspect who allegedly colluded online with the killer before the mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge, B.C., was denied bail on Tuesday in a Federal Court in Seattle, Wash.

articles.title: 2 men charged days after fatal collision in Scarborough: police
articles.summary: Two men have been charged following a fatal collision in Scarborough on Sunday, police say.

articles.title: Man facing arson charge week after hundreds of Israeli flags torched at North York church: police
